responses.text: {Lucky 38 re-lit}It turns out the Lucky 38 had its own reactor all along. Now that it's operational, the city doesn't need power from the dam.
{Hated 1}You're just as bad as the NCR or the Legion. What did the Followers ever do to you?
{Hated 2}People like you are the reason the Followers haven't brought civilization back to the wasteland yet.
{Hated 3}I don't know what you have against the Followers, but I don't want any trouble.
{Liked 1}You're always welcome among the Followers, friend.
{Liked 2}The Followers are lucky to have a friend like you.
{Liked 3}If you ever need the assistance of the Followers, just ask.
{Mixed 1}You're making it hard to trust you, you know.
{Mixed 2}At least you've making up for some of the trouble you've caused.
{Mixed 3}They said you're friendly enough, but that we ought to keep an eye on you.
{Rascal 1}I hear you've done some good things for the Followers.
{Rascal 2}The Followers are always on the look on for new friends like yourself.
{Rascal 3}I appreciate how you've been helping us so far.
{Thug 2}I really don't have anything you'd want.
{Thug 3}Look, I've got people to care for. I'm not looking for trouble.
{Wild Child 1}I don't get you. Sometimes you help the Followers, and other times you work against us.
{Wild Child 2}You're an enemy of the Followers, as far as I'm concerned. I don't care how you've helped us.
{Wild Child 3}The Followers can't trust you, you've proven that.
{Securitrons at Fort Destroyed}I never imagined Mr. House would concede to the NCR. I wonder what convinced him...
{Default}When people have got nothing left, they can always turn to the Followers.
{Random - Guard}The Gun Runners ought to help the Followers by donating some of that firepower they've got.
{Random - Guard}{slightly complaining}Wish the Followers would get me some better armor.
{Random - Guard}Stay alert.
{Random - Guard}Keep an eye out for trouble.
{Companion Reaction - Veronica}I didn't know the Brotherhood had any people out here.
{Companion Reaction - Rex}Look at that - a cyber-dog. There can't be many of those left.
{Companion Reaction - Lily}{awe}Look at that - a friendly Nightkin. What's it doing here?
{Companion Reaction - ED-E}{a bit amused}That is one battered Eyebot. It's a miracle it's still functioning.
{Companion Reaction - Cass}Isn't that Cass? I heard she'd gotten out of the caravan business.
{Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe}That's a First Recon beret. They're the best marksmen in the NCR military.
{Companion Reaction - Raul}I'll never get used to the sight of ghouls.
{Brotherhood of Steel Destroyed}The Brotherhood had a bunker in Hidden Valley, but it was destroyed somehow.
{Kings resolve differences with NCR}I never thought I'd see the day when the NCR and the Kings started getting along.
{Kings wiped out}{shock at a bloodbath}The Kings got hit hard. I don't know how many of them are still alive, if any.
{Kimball Assassination Successful}President Kimball was careless and overconfident, and it got him killed.
{Kimball Assassination Failed}Who would have thought someone would try to assassinate President Kimball with all those troops around?
{Monorail destroyed}Did you see the monorail explode? The destruction was absolute.
{Caesar dead}Caesar's death is good news for the NCR. For everyone, most likely.
{Mr. House unplugged/killed}No one knows how Mr. House died. His obituary didn't say anything useful.
{Securitrons on the Strip Upgraded}The Securitrons in and around the Strip have been upgraded. It's almost like Vegas has an army now.
{Player enters Lucky 38}Someone entered the Lucky 38. That's never happened before.
{Player foiled RACKET}Big shakeup in the management at Gomorrah. I wonder what that's about?
{Player killed Benny at The Tops}Someone killed Benny, the Chairmen's bigshot, in his own casino. Violence begets violence...
{Player assaulted The Tops}Did you hear about the shootout at The Tops?
{Thug 1}We're only trying to help people, and you're not making it easy on us.
All right. I'll let it go - {emphasis "this"}this time.
{annoyed}You're lucky we Followers tend to be forgiving.
I know where to hit you where it hurts the most.
The wasteland will be more civilized without you!
{versus Mutated Insect}Damn giant bugs!
{versus Abomination}I don't think I've had to kill one of these things before.
{taunting}Fighting was part of my studies.
We Followers aren't pushovers!
{angry at being pushed into a fight}I didn't want to have to do this!
